name: Implement a minimal HHL-style solver in Qiskit for the 2x2 system A x = b with A
task_prompt: Implement a minimal HHL-style solver in Qiskit for the 2x2 system A x = b with A = [[2.0, 1.0], [1.0, 2.0]], b = [1, 0]: run QPE with 3 clock qubits, invert eigenvalues via controlled-RY rotations, post-select on the ancilla, and compare the normalized solution with numpy.linalg.solve. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
